scope: All56 numbered Group I finding groups; source-reviewed gaps and unproven runtime cases distinguished. No installed fixes or full audits.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Counter
claims.reason: Current carrier 133530841 and all its literal prompts exist in candidate DB; replacing STRING_ID with id is not an established fix.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Counter
claims.reason: Optional destruction prompt precedes checking a nonempty eligible group. This can produce an unnecessary prompt; it is not proof an illegal destruction occurs.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Counter
claims.reason: Printed text allows one card in your field and does not exclude itself. Report supplies no authoritative universal prohibition or actual resolving Counter Trap self-destruction failure. Do not remove a printed choice solely on this assertion.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Counter
claims.reason: Destruction-by-effect trigger may need Damage Step flags depending on native automatic event allowances. Missing a flag alone does not establish failure, especially the report conflates battle destruction with REASON_EFFECT condition.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Counter
claims.reason: Numeric id+100 is a supported legacy Omega name-shared count convention. Modern table formatting is not required to implement a distinct named effect.

claims.name: Talismandrake Arms United
claims.reason: Current carrier 133034223 and all its literal prompts exist in candidate DB; replacing STRING_ID with id is not an established fix.

claims.name: Talismandrake Arms United
claims.reason: Predicate omits IsForbidden. Need actual prohibition and Pendulum placement behavior; syntax-valid omission does not alone prove an illegal placement.

claims.name: Talismandrake Arms United
claims.reason: eqop reuses cfilter with e, which includes IsCanBeEffectTarget. Target immunity gained after activation should not invalidate an existing target solely as targeting immunity. Preserve relation, equip eligibility and required recipient type checks.

claims.name: Talismandrake Arms United
claims.reason: Four-code list limits supported equip implementations. Printed Arms scope must be compared against all actual cards before expanding. DARK checks may reflect individual Arms equip limitations because text says as if equipped by its effect; do not automatically allow incompatible recipients.

claims.name: Talismandrake Arms United
claims.reason: Duplicated code is a maintainability risk, not proof effects are wrong. Shared equip refactoring must preserve each weapon-specific value, limit and replacement.

claims.name: Maiden of Talismandrakes Seraphina
claims.reason: Current carrier 132142234 and all its literal prompts exist in candidate DB; replacing STRING_ID with id is not an established fix.

claims.name: Maiden of Talismandrakes Seraphina
claims.reason: Pendulum effect shares id with all named previous monster effects despite having no printed named restriction. Shared monster effect scope and each-versus-shared wording need their own treatment; separating every trigger indiscriminately is not necessarily correct.

claims.name: Maiden of Talismandrakes Seraphina
claims.reason: Printed also use lock follows the cost separator, but source installs it during LP payment. Negated activation can therefore leave an unintended lock. Actual two-turn duration/reset must also be verified.

claims.name: Maiden of Talismandrakes Seraphina
claims.claim: 4. **Line 100 (`psptg`):** Unconditionally sets `Duel.SetOperationInfo(0, CATEGORY_EQUIP, nil, 1, tp, LOCATION_GRAVE)` for an optional action.
claims.reason: Unconditional equip operation information for optional equip may overstate possible action; it is not evidence optional equip is forced or fails.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Dactylus
claims.reason: Current carrier 133637994 and all its literal prompts exist in candidate DB; replacing STRING_ID with id is not an established fix.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Dactylus
claims.claim: 2. **Line 49 (`s.checkop`):** Dinosaur monsters destroyed in the Spell & Trap Zone (e.g. Pendulum Zone or Equip) are ignored because `tc:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_MZONE)` is strictly required.
claims.reason: Non-archetype Dinosaur recognition only covers previous MZONE or HAND. A monster placed in SZONE may currently be a Spell/Trap, so original race alone is not sufficient to declare it a Dinosaur monster. Test actual type/race semantics for equip and Pendulum cards.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Dactylus
claims.claim: 3. **Lines 71–80 (`s.spop1`):** Negation applied after summon instead of atomically with `SpecialSummonStep`. Missing `SetValue(RESET_TURN_SET)` on `EFFECT_DISABLE_EFFECT`.
claims.reason: Source applies disable effects after SpecialSummon finishes rather than before SpecialSummonComplete. Source also omits RESET_TURN_SET value on DISABLE_EFFECT. Actual summoned trigger timing and face-down reset cases are needed to show the behavioral difference.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Dactylus
claims.reason: Actual effect-destruction trigger during Damage Step needed; flag omission is not a reproduced failure.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
claims.reason: Current carrier 132898203 and all its literal prompts exist in candidate DB; replacing STRING_ID with id is not an established fix.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
claims.reason: Full MMZ fails unconditional GetLocationCount>0 even if destroying an eligible own MMZ monster frees a zone. Must evaluate a valid destruction choice that actually frees an allowed zone, not just any field card.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
claims.claim: 3. **Line 41 (`s.desfilter`):** Unnecessarily restricts targets to `c:IsFaceup()`, preventing destruction of face-down Chrono-Saur Spells/Traps.
claims.reason: Face-up restriction excludes own face-down Chrono-Saur cards despite no printed qualifier. Own card information is known to its controller. Test face-down spell/trap and Dinosaur separately.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
claims.reason: Phase cleanup stores only card object and current MZONE membership, so leaving and returning can be destroyed as the old summoned instance. Add instance/flag tracking only after actual leave-return counterexample.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
claims.reason: aux.NecroValleyFilter supports nil and returns a callable closure. Invoking it inline with c is valid Lua and supported Omega helper usage.

claims.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
claims.claim: 6. **Line 37 (`s.spcon1`):** Missing Damage Step exclusion in Quick Effect.
claims.reason: Default free-chain summon Quick Effects are not automatically allowed in Damage Step just because a phase predicate spans Battle Phase. Native activation gate must be tested before claiming an explicit exclusion is mandatory.

claims.name: Talismandrake Enkindle
claims.reason: Current carrier 133706191 and all its literal prompts exist in candidate DB; replacing STRING_ID with id is not an established fix.

claims.name: Talismandrake Enkindle
claims.reason: Comparative libcard.cpp:2473 defaults omitted player to core.reason_player. Numerous Omega official scripts call IsAbleToRemove() without tp. Possible wrong-context cases need a specific trace, not a mandatory-argument claim.

claims.name: Talismandrake Enkindle
claims.reason: The relation is to the original activated effect re. Handler moving as its own cost occurs before the responding chain link; this is not equivalent to moving later in the chain. An actual self-cost activation case is required before removing relation checks.

claims.name: Talismandrake Enkindle
claims.reason: armseqfilter relies on a four-code equip list despite printed any Talismandrake Arms card. Check roster/set membership and broaden activation prerequisite independently of the weapon application implementation.

claims.name: Talismandrake Enkindle
claims.claim: 5. **Lines 100–190:** Over 90 lines of redundant duplicate equip logic.
claims.reason: Duplicated equip implementation merits shared helper work only with behavior-preserving checks; length alone is not an engine violation.

claims.name: To Proto Chrono
claims.reason: Current carrier 132013196 and all its literal prompts exist in candidate DB; replacing STRING_ID with id is not an established fix.

claims.name: To Proto Chrono
claims.reason: Printed negate clause does not target, but script sets CARD_TARGET and selects a target during activation. Resolution-time selection should retain face-up/legal monster and actual negation eligibility without adding targeting restrictions.

claims.name: To Proto Chrono
claims.reason: Source does not separate negation from subsequent stat gain with BreakEffect. Success/immunity and stat-gain dependence must be retained; adding timing alone does not complete the effect.

claims.name: To Proto Chrono
claims.reason: Current operation only increments Card turn counters. Omega Pyro Clock c1082946 recognizes flag1082946 and invokes the stored countdown effect operation. These are different tracking systems. Advancing all printed effect turn counts requires appropriate integration; blindly incrementing displayed counters is insufficient.

claims.name: Talismandrake Sear
claims.reason: Target feasibility requires Pendulum-zone summon option, blocking otherwise legal independent Extra-to-Pendulum placement option. Preserve optional independent also branches and check each destination/recipient properly.
